authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner records Lahnda/Punjabi/Western Pahari choṭā/choṭṭā, Kumaoni/Nepali choṭo, Bengali/Oriya choṭa and Gujarati choṭũ small/short under *chōṭṭa. These simple survey forms share its affricate-retroflex stem, with regional aspiration, vowel and diminutive-ending variation retained. Mixed alternatives, small-big echo compounds and Kullui ocə forms are excluded; the comparative family does not by itself settle recent Hindi influence.
